source.description: PROBLEM: docs/ (1.6M) and README.md predate ~230 commits of v0.13.0 scope (skills-v4, python-kernel, service-knowledge, Exa MCP, memory retirement, global-only hooks); prose describes a reality that no longer exists. SUCCESS: README rewritten from live tree (draft PR); docs/ audited against changelog, stale spots fixed, tree green. SCOPE: README.md + docs/ + managed tops if generated. NON_GOALS: new features; specialists-repo docs; CHANGELOG edits. CONSTRAINTS: branch docs/readme-refresh for README (draft PR, no merge until review); docs fixes on branch docs/sync-release-reality; no origin mutation beyond pushes; verify doc claims against live code. VALIDATION: targeted tests green; reviewer pass on README; grep stale terms clean. OUTPUT: draft README PR + docs-sync PR. SCRUTINY: MEDIUM.
source.title: Docs sync to release reality + README rewrite
